name: pith-ui
description: Native TypeScript parts and shared region recipes with fixed presentation.

scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e "import {rmSync} from 'node:fs';rmSync('test-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test-dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:package: node scripts/release.ts pack && node scripts/release.ts verify
scripts.validate: npm run build && npm run check && npm test && npm run test:tools && node scripts/catalog.ts && node scripts/api-docs.ts --check && node scripts/verify-assemblies.ts && npm run test:browser && npm run showroom:build && npm run test:package
